description: Implementation of the rx::ImageEGL class for managing EGL images in the ANGLE graphics library, including creation, initialization, and binding to textures and renderbuffers.

classes.name: ImageEGL
classes.description: Class managing EGL images, including creation, binding to textures and renderbuffers, and cleanup.

methods.name: ImageEGL
methods.description: Constructor initializing the ImageEGL object with image state, context, target, attributes, and EGL functions.

methods.name: ~ImageEGL
methods.description: Destructor that destroys the EGL image resource.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the EGL image based on the target type (texture, renderbuffer, external image).

methods.name: orphan
methods.description: Handles orphaning of the EGL image; no action needed as it is automatic.

methods.name: setTexture2D
methods.description: Binds the EGL image to a 2D texture.

methods.name: setRenderbufferStorage
methods.description: Binds the EGL image to a renderbuffer.
